scope: Declared complete fictional R0-R18 deterministic dispute prototype; voice/two-reviewer customer success is dated supporting evidence; larger fleet and production certification are distinct scopes.

dimensions.name: technical judgment
dimensions.justification: Complete pure ordered policy coupled to real owned-read, query isolation, consent/snapshot binding, receipt/recovery and revocation source; fresh 1078-check core pass. Remaining gap is current joined every-branch customer acceptance, not real-bank certification.

dimensions.name: AI engineering
dimensions.justification: Actual parallel stage barrier, validated prompts/repair/fallback, durable bounded reviewer work and integrated exact speech acknowledgments. Dated two-worker success is demonstrated; expanded fleet, wider bilingual sample and human audio assessment are unqualified.

dimensions.name: data engineering
dimensions.justification: Row-accounted contracted bronze/silver/gold, quarantine/lineage/dedup, customer ownership and immutable atomic publication. Seven fresh fixture invariants pass. Historical private aggregate not recomputed; S3 inventory is not VersionId-pinned and cleanup remains operational.

dimensions.name: ML/evaluation
dimensions.justification: Leakage diagnosis, training-only parameter selection, fixed independent AI-authored bilingual holdout, multiple baselines, errors and abstention tradeoff. Luna audit independently reproduces 100 correct outputs and deterministic tie. Human labels, broader linguistic diversity and end-to-end held-out benefit remain absent.

dimensions.name: data analytics
dimensions.justification: Read-only metadata/HMAC pipeline and honest outcome/node metrics with decision-changing evidence and paired uncertainty. Analytics/inquiry tests pass. Full host outcome joins, durable model cost/token capture and pilot business outcomes remain missing.

dimensions.name: architecture/extensibility
dimensions.justification: Reusable FlowSpec/chat/runner/MCP/model adapter contracts and trusted extension hooks; generic default stays free of banking integration. Independent example is illustrative rather than run.

dimensions.name: execution/integration
dimensions.justification: Typed inline/saved execution, invocation contexts/events/cancellation, tool audience/argument/progress handling and historical load/collaboration evidence. Live transports/providers and expanded customer fleet are not freshly qualified.

dimensions.name: safety/recovery
dimensions.justification: Pinned snapshots/logs, authority fences, approvals, bounded retry and unknown-effect manual recovery. Locks are process-local, replay trusts tool annotations, ordinary approval defaults are permissive; crash/cross-process/endurance coverage remains limited.

dimensions.name: reproducible engineering
dimensions.justification: 39 exact copied upstream files and five fresh retry checks plus transparent historical104 selected tests. Eleven direct cache/lock mismatches, unresolved imports in subset and no clean install/full build/full suite limit qualification.

dimensions.name: developer usability
dimensions.justification: Clear interface guide, pins, examples, commands and non-banking use case; broader replay needs another full checkout and hosted copied-Markdown supporting links are broken by relocation.

first_five_findings_in_discovery_order: Explicit general-purpose FLUJO product boundary; banking authority belongs to the application/MCP or isolated authorized branch.
Complete deterministic R0-R18 core is independent of voice/fleet and subsequently passes fresh source replay.
Two actual bounded model reviewers, useful saved suggestions and retained context are supported by original receipts.
Infrastructure capacity and unaccepted expanded fleet are separately scoped; disabled provider blocks root before delegation.
Ownership defects and template leakage change product grounding and evaluation design.
